narrative: A bill in black letter, in the tiring-house light, before he goes down to Bishopsgate. The title is the whole of it. No man's name is printed under the title. The river is not in the picture, and he does not start toward it. The same bill, still in his hand at the door. The afternoon at the Theatre is his own. He lets the sheet go to the peg where the bills are kept, and the peg is as far as it travels.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the title, and did not start for the river.

entities.name: Harry the Fifth
entities.context: Shown on bill in Harry the Fifth
